messages:
maria_sales: HelixSoft POC stuck provisioning dedicated pool in ap-southeast1. UI shows "allocating" for 15m, customer impatient. Anyone seeing errors?
jamal_eng: paste reservation id and config?
maria_sales: resv=resv-9c7d11, region=ap-southeast1, az_affinity=ap-southeast1-a, requested_gpus=6.
nina_cs: customer screenshot: error banner "Provision failed: affinity mismatch" and retry button.
sanjay_infra: looking at provider logs: many 429s on node create + capacity 0 in ap-southeast1-a. snippet: 
``nHTTP 429 QuotaExceeded: request_rate_exceeded
allocate: AZ ap-southeast1-a has 0 available GPUs
```
alice_sre: two problems: provider rate limiting + absolute shortage in requested AZ. Single-AZ requests for POCs are fragile. We need a short-term workaround and an ops follow-up.
maria_sales: customer insisted on single-AZ for compliance during demo. They can accept a short change if we document it.
jamal_eng: plan: 1) temporarily relax AZ strictness on resv-9c7d11 and retry 2) throttle our provisioning retries (backoff) to avoid hitting provider 429s 3) open quota ticket with partner for ap-southeast1-a
sanjay_infra: I'll bump our internal rate allowance for this account for 3 min and add exponential backoff. Also opening partner ticket now.
partner-bot: partner-ticket created: CP-5499 (quota + capacity check)
jamal_eng: requeued provisioning with target_azs=[ap-southeast1-a,ap-southeast1-b] and fallback enabled. watching logs.
partner-bot: provisioning result: allocated 6 GPUs in ap-southeast1-b.
maria_sales: customer confirmed pool visible, console shows new nodes. They accepted temporary AZ change.
nina_cs: I'll send customer note: explain why we relaxed AZ, mitigation, offer scheduled migration back when quota confirmed.
alice_sre: follow-ups: add UI warning for single-AZ POCs, document recommended fallback_policy for sales, and track CP-5499 until quota is granted.
maria_sales: thanks team. Can someone estimate ETA to move back to ap-southeast1-a?
sanjay_infra: once quota confirmed, 24-48h to migrate.
jamal_eng: created PR to add opt-in flag `--allow-temporary-az-relax` for resvctl: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/resvctl/pulls/489
maria_sales: perfect. closing thread after postmortem notes are in the sales POC playbook. :white_check_mark:
